note: Command-line tools whose install folder the shim rule cannot see (#225). Each entry names one exact install folder, removed whole; the shims in ~/.local/bin that go with it, removed only when they point into that folder; and the settings that stay. Never list a folder shared with something else, such as ~/.gemini, ~/.config or ~/.local/share itself. A tool whose shim in ~/.local/bin points into its own ~/.<tool> folder needs no entry.
